title: SignalShap: Exact Ranking-Stage Attribution of Sources in Hybrid Recommenders (code and artefacts)
description: Code, frozen configuration, and every artefact JSON backing the numbers in the manuscript 'SignalShap: Exact Ranking-Stage Attribution of Sources in Hybrid Recommenders'. Recasts hybrid-recommender source attribution as a five-player cooperative game with fixed-candidate NDCG@10 as the characteristic function, computed by exact enumeration over all 32 coalitions. Includes the analytic validation suite, the ten-seed retirement experiment, and the negative fusion result. Benchmark corpora are not redistributed; fetch scripts are provided.
